player_prompt.intro: Waxaad tahay ciyaaryahanka {player_id} ee ku xir afar. Calaamadda diskkaaga: {symbol}. Guddiga ciyaarta wuxuu leeyahay {num_rows} saf iyo {num_cols} tiir. Ciyaartoydu waxay isbeddelaan iyagoo u dhigaya diskooda mid ka mid ah tiirarka (0 ilaa {end_col}). Qofka ugu horreeya ee isku xira (afarkooda) afar diskood oo toosan, jiif ah, ama si siman ayaa ku guuleysta. Markaad soo wareegto, ku qor lambarka tiirka qaybaha laba jibbaaran si aad u dhaqaajiso. Tusaale ahaan: '[col 4]' ama '[col 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id}, Qaabka ficil aan ansax ahayn. Qaabka la filayo: "[col x]".
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id}, ficil aan ansax ahayn. Tiirka {col} waa ka baxsan yahay.
invalid_move.already_full: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id}, ficil aan ansax ahayn. Tiirka {col} waa buuxsan yahay.

action.dropped_disk: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} ayaa ku tuuray diskigiisa ({player_symbol}) safka {col}.

outcome.win: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} ayaa ku guuleysta isagoo isku xiray afar!
